text: Algorithm 1 FLEX - Pre-training and Tuning 1: \mathbf{G(X,A)} , \mathbf{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times d} 2: Extract \mathbf{G_{s}} from 1-hop enclosed subgraphs of A 3: Retrieve \mathbf{Z} using the zero-one labeling trick, Eq. ( 6 ) 4: for epoch = 1 to pretrain do 5: Train SIG-VAE on \mathbf{G_{s}} using Eq. ( 2 ) and labels \mathbf{Z} 6: end for 7: for epoch = 1 to flex-tune do 8: Sample \mathbf{G_{s}^{\prime}} from SIG-VAE 9: Apply Eq. ( 6 ) on \mathbf{G_{s}^{\prime}} 10: Train GNN + SIG-VAE on \mathbf{G_{s}^{\prime}} using Eq. ( 8 ) 11: end for

Algorithm 2 Node-Aware Decoder Algorithm 1: 2: x\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times F} : Node features, A=\mathrm{diag}(A_{1},\dots,A_{K}) : Block-diagonal adjacency 3: \mathbf{Z}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times d} : Structural features, J : Truncation index, n_{train}=[\mathcal{N}_{1},\dots,\mathcal{N}_{N}] : Training Nodes 4: (\mu,\log\sigma^{2},\mathrm{SNR})\leftarrow\mathrm{Encoder}(x,A,Z) 5: \mu^{\prime}\leftarrow\mu_{J:N} , \log\sigma^{\prime 2}\leftarrow\log\sigma^{2}_{J:N} 6: Split \mu^{\prime},\log\sigma^{\prime 2} into subgraphs \mu_{i},\log\sigma_{i}^{2} using n_{train} 7: for i=1 to N do 8: Sample \epsilon_{i}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I) 9: z_{i}\leftarrow\mu_{i}+\epsilon_{i}\odot\exp(0.5\cdot\log\sigma_{i}^{2}) \triangleright Reparametrization Trick 10: (\hat{A}_{i},z_{i}^{\text{scaled}},r_{k})\leftarrow\mathrm{Decoder}(z_{i}) 11: Insert \hat{A}_{i} into \hat{A}_{\text{global}} at block (i,i) 12: Insert z_{i} , z_{i}^{\text{scaled}} , \epsilon_{i} into global tensors 13: end for 14: return \hat{A}_{\text{global}},\mu,\log\sigma^{2},\mathbf{Z}_{\text{global}},\mathbf{Z}_{\text{global}}^{\text{scaled}},\epsilon_{\text{global}},r_{k},\mathrm{SNR}
